title: Shinonome Ena — That Drawing, Together〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?! What gives?! Why am I small all of a sudden?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I know this is SEKAI, but there are limits, right?!
Oh, no. Don't tell me I'm stuck like this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: E-Ena, let's just calm down...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For now, let's go over what we know.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: First, I think this is a SEKAI made from a fragment of Ena's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which means that the shard Ena touched came from a fragment of a feeling that belonged to Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I did think that earlier. All these pictures and photos have to do with me, after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honestly, if this was actually somebody else's SEKAI that would be a lot scarier...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But then, why was it a shard anyway? Are everyone's fragments of feelings shaped differently or something?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... I think everyone's are meant to be round and glowing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think yours...just got broken, somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? That can happen?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If someone disregards your feelings, or you deny them yourself, or forget them, or try to suppress them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When things like that happen, they can get clouded, and crack or even break, I think.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't think it happens much unless something really bad happens...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, what was up with the little me we met? She was able to talk just fine...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That was probably a part of your feelings or memories left inside the fragment.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But...since it was broken, she couldn't maintain her form.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, so, we thought if you and she touched, she might not have to disappear...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But instead, she's gone and our Ena turned little.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess you two didn't expect this to happen any more than I did...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: W-Wait, what's happening?! I'm glowing again!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think the shard is starting to vanish again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But if the feelings are back with their owner, shouldn't it be okay now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Maybe the feelings have changed too much, and can't go back to how they were.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If we can figure out what feelings this fragment is made from, she might be able to return to her original form...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So basically, if we can figure out what's going on, that little me doesn't have to disappear?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes, but it probably won't be that easy...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't care if it won't be easy. I'll do it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't need my own feelings vanishing off into nowhere before I can have a look at them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, Ena. Let's go find those feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's this scribbly weird picture?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a bunny, obviously.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It looks like I drew it holding a crayon in my fist, so this must be from when I was really little.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, there's a photo of you and the others looking at cherry blossoms together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's from the mystery tour Mizuki organized for us. The photo turned out so well I made sure to get a copy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh, there are even pieces I did for Mr. Yukihira's assignments... And these are the awful ones...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've looked around a lot, but I still don't know what feelings this SEKAI is made from.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There are pictures I drew when I was really little, but also stuff from junior high and even things I drew this year.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And it's not just pictures, but photos too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I really don't know what's up with that. I thought the feelings would be something to do with art, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It just feels like everything's slapped up on the wall looking for attention.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If that's how you see her, I feel bad for that little Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why? I barely remember what I was like as a kid, but the one we talked to seemed like a little brat.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Well, if she's really going to disappear because I can't figure this feeling thing out, I guess I do feel a little bad for her.)

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: Aww. I wanted to go see the picture together...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Actually, I wonder what she meant by “the picture”?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, the one little Ena mentioned. She said she wanted to see it together...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Maybe there's a hint there or something.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Was this flower drawing here before?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, look at that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I remember this one... I drew it in elementary school, I think?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The flower's way too big compared to the stem and leaves... Well, I guess there's no point critiquing a child's drawing.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry for getting distracted, you two. I was saying, maybe we should look for that picture...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's weird. I feel like I could look at this picture for hours...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... Why does it feel so bright? Do you think it's because she was happy to find the flower?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's just a picture I drew and yet they're really looking at it so seriously...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (How it felt to find the flower...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (True, the flower is drawn so big, even though the proportions are totally off.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I must have really just wanted to draw the flower...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait... I think I remember. I saw this flower when I was playing outside...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I think I drew it because I wanted to show it to Mom and everyone and let them see how pretty it was.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wonder what kind of flower it is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you think the real flower is as pretty a blue as this?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's like they're really getting something out of it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The more I look at it... It's just a child's picture, just a drawing of a flower, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never realized I used to be so honest with myself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm back...?
You found the picture.

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: Good job to me. I knew I could do it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, you know. I couldn't have you vanishing on me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, are you starting to vanish again?!

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: I'm not going away. I'm coming back to you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You really like startling me, don't you? I'm going to have a heart attack over here.

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: You make the people around you worry just as much as I do, though.

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: Really, there's a whole lot more I want you to realize...

rows.Speaker: Little Ena
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll be fine without my help. You're me, after all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You really are a little brat, huh.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It looks like we made it back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... Ena, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm fine. Actually, I feel weirdly refreshed.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It sure felt weird visiting a SEKAI made from my own feelings, though...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was surprised too... But I'm glad your feelings didn't end up vanishing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right. It may have been just a little fragment, but it's part of something precious to you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Rin, Len, thank you both. You really helped me out there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright! Time for me to head home and get back to work on that assignment.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? But what about your break?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm fine. Actually, I feel pretty motivated all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even though you were just saying you didn't know what to do?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I think what I felt in that SEKAI has given me a bit of a hint.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. It's a subjective prompt, so I got all tangled up in interpretations and representations...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it really just comes down to what I want to convey, and how I want to draw it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So I'm just going to empty my mind and face it with a pure heart.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see. I hope it goes well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll be great, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
Okay, I'm gonna get to work!
